name: Asaka Tamaki
source: The game's protagonist who always had excellent grades in school. A pretty normal school boy who has a strong sense of justice and also the first transfer student at Namiya Gakuen. He's a cheerful person and very polite. Because he's attending an all-boys school he doesn't have much contact with the opposite sex, but he was not very interested in romance in the first place.
